grades.lower_bound_mechanism: greedy killing -> permanent with cofactor <= a_1 (Lemma 7) -> finiteness via antichain/self-duality
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: L = lcm of finitely many permanents; T = count of members in [a_1, a_1+L)
grades.notes: Complete, correct proof. Lemmas 1-2 give the full membership characterization; Lemmas 6-7 plus the Theorem prove finiteness of permanents via greedy killing and an antichain contradiction (all cases, not examples); Lemma 8 yields a_{n+T}=a_n+L from n=1. Minor wording: 'exactly' in Lemma 3(c) should read 'finite minimal transversals'; the proof only uses valid directions.
